summary.text: Julie Brixie is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 73 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia lists her House service as beginning in 2019.
She previously served on the Meridian Township Board and holds a master's degree in crop and soil sciences from Michigan State University.

paragraphs.text: Brixie earned a bachelor's degree in physical geography from the University of Illinois and a master's degree in crop and soil sciences from Michigan State University.
She served on the Meridian Township Board before joining the legislature.
In the 2021-2022 session Brixie was minority vice chair of the House Oversight Committee.
In 2025-2026 she serves on the Economic Competitiveness and Energy committees.
She advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Joshua Rockey in the general election on November 3, 2026.
